findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like debug_backtrace(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$class_name" was changed on line 38. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: func_get_args() and similar report the current value of a changed parameter, and code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this, so the upgrade changes nothing)

The left-associativity of the ternary operator has been deprecated in PHP 7.4 and removed in PHP 8.0. Multiple consecutive ternaries detected. Use parenthesis to clarify the order in which the operations should be executed (inside a match expression, so this file already compiles only on PHP 8, where an unparenthesised nested ternary is a compile error; the rule misreads parenthesised ternaries here)
